name: or the built-in ones (tube
Trotting a float
gist: Let a float run downstream at the speed of the current with the bait just off the bottom.
gear: A long rod helps more than an expensive one. 6 lb line, a 4 g float, size 10 hook.
how: Set the float over-deep, trot it through, and shorten until it stops dragging under.|Cast slightly upstream and let the float settle before it reaches you.|Let it travel at the speed of the surface, no faster.|Hold a little line back every few seconds so the bait lifts and falls again.|Strike downstream, not up.
tell: The float lifts, holds under, or slides sideways against the current. Any of those is a fish.
fail: Fishing too shallow. If you never tick bottom you are fishing above them.
